title: knowgov who-knows report
description: What `python harness/who_knows.py` prints and the MCP tool who_knows returns (task-0360, decision-0047 point 2): for exactly one register node, key or code path, the handles whose attested evidence touches it and their holders. Read from files across every subject the reader serves (KG_SUBJECTS) and their one register (KG_REGISTER), never from the store, so the report is the same on either store. The scope is one hop, never a walk: nodes and keys name what was read. Per handle: its unit, roles, issued and withdrawn dates as the register's issued list holds them (listed false for a handle the files name that the list does not), its holder (the register's person, ieam-register decision 0021) or null with holder_why, and its evidence items sorted by kind, then key (a node for owns), then date; handles sorted by id. No count, rank, weight or score. Version 1; a change is additive or a new version. Exit 2 prints no report.

key.description: the key the item rests on (every kind but owns)

subject.description: the subject whose capture folder holds it (every kind but owns)

on.description: the capture's or the review's date, YYYY-MM-DD (every kind but owns)

capture.description: answered: the statement id the load gives the answer or the nobody-knows, A:cap:<stem>:<n>@capture

nobody_knows.description: answered: true for a nobody-knows, false for an answer

review.description: approved, rejected, closed: the review's id as the load gives it, review:<stem>

statement.description: approved, rejected: the statement the ruling names

gap.description: closed: the declared gap the review closes

node.description: owns: the node in scope the handle's unit owns

via.description: owns: the node's owner field, or an approved owns link

asked.description: the one thing asked, a key in NFC

nodes.description: the register nodes in scope, sorted

code.description: for a path: the application or module code_map.toml assigns it, and the keys its header cites; else null

subjects.description: the subjects read, in the reader's order

unread.description: the subjects under KG_SUBJECTS that did not load, each with why

issued_list.description: the register's issued list read, relative to its root (types.toml [elicited] issued); null when it names none

listed.description: whether the register's issued list names the handle

holder.description: the register's person for the handle (ieam-register decision 0021); null when none is recorded

holder_why.description: why holder is null; null when it is not
